define function is_capitalized with parameter s  
    go through each index i in the range of length of s  
        set c to s[i]  
        if c is not an alphabet  
            if not (i is equal to length of s minus 1 and c is equal to '.')  
                return False  
    if s ends with '.'  
        set s to s without the last character  
    go through each character c in s starting from index 1  
        if c is not a lowercase letter  
            return False  
    return s[0] is an uppercase letter

set capitalizeds to list of items from words where is_capitalized returns True
